author: ValWood
body:
These are all upstream of the first step in these pathways.
For example, the first step in de novo methionine biosynthesis is  considered to be met6 (pombe) MET2 (S. cerevisiae)

If the GO annotations are kept they should be causally_upstream rather than involved_in (i.e part_of)
